metadata.title: Lindenya Dental Clinic · Kadıköy, Istanbul
metadata.description: A calm dental clinic in Moda, Kadıköy. See real free times and book online in English or Turkish.

home.title: A calmer way to care for your smile in Istanbul.
home.lead: Check-ups, whitening, implants and aligners with four dentists who take the time to explain. See a real free time and book online in under a minute.
home.artLabel: Illustration of a tooth with a linden leaf
home.treatmentsLead: Every treatment shows how long it takes, so you can plan the rest of your day.
home.dentistsLead: Small enough to remember your name, broad enough to cover the whole family.
home.reviewsTag: Demo reviews, written for this showcase
home.review1: I've avoided dentists for years. Dr. Aydın explained every step and it was over before I knew it.
home.review2: Booked from London on Sunday night, saw Dr. Kaya on Tuesday morning. Everything in English, no fuss.
home.review3: My son actually asked when he can go back. That has never happened before.
home.intlBody: Our whole team speaks English. Book before you fly, and every time you see is Istanbul time.
home.ctaBody: Pick a time that suits you, or give us a call and we'll help you choose.

treatments.title: Care for every stage of your smile
treatments.lead: Seven treatments, each with a clear duration. Not sure which one you need? Book a check-up and we'll guide you from there.
treatments.visit1: Choose a free time that suits you. You'll get a confirmation email straight away.
treatments.visit2: We'll go through your health history over a cup of tea, never in a rush.
treatments.visit3: Your dentist explains what they found and what comes next, in plain words.

dentists.title: The people behind Lindenya
dentists.lead: Four dentists with different specialties, sharing one way of working: explain first, treat gently, follow up.

international.title: Visiting Kadıköy from abroad
international.lead: Whether you live here or are in town for a week, booking with us works the same way: online, in English, with real free times.
international.englishBody: Every dentist and our front desk speak English, and Turkish of course. Your emails and reminders come in the language you book in.
international.timeBody: The times you see are Istanbul time (GMT+3, all year round), wherever you are booking from.
international.quoteBody: We never start work without agreeing a plan and a quote with you first.
international.step1Title: Pick a treatment and a time
international.step1: Choose online. If you're unsure, a check-up is the best place to start.
international.step2: You receive an email with a calendar file and a link to change or cancel.
international.step3: Use the link in your email to move or cancel up to 24 hours before.
international.step4: We're a short walk from the Kadıköy ferry pier.
international.gettingBody: Kadıköy is on the Asian side of Istanbul. Ferries run from Karaköy and Eminönü, and the Marmaray line stops at Ayrılık Çeşmesi nearby. From the pier, follow Moda Caddesi south for about ten minutes.

contact.title: Come and see us in Moda
contact.lead: Call, write or drop by. If you'd rather we call you, leave your number below.
contact.mapLabel: Illustrated map showing the clinic on Moda Caddesi, near the Kadıköy ferry pier
contact.callbackBody: Leave your name and number and we'll call you back, usually the same working day.

footer.tagline: A small dental clinic in Moda, Kadıköy.
footer.demoNote: Lindenya is a fictional clinic, built as a portfolio demo. Names, addresses, phone numbers and reviews are invented.
